name: Failed Logons Then Logon Then Account Created
description: Three or more failed logons (4625), then a successful logon (4624), then a new user account (4720) on the same computer — guessing that works, followed by an account to keep the access. Longer than a two-step rule and correspondingly rarer, but the steps need only appear in this order on the host, not back to back, and are not matched by account.
